analysis.executive_summary: The dataset comprises 12,575 retail transactions across 25 customers, 8 categories, and 200 items, spanning both online and in-store channels. Key metrics include price per unit, quantity, and total spent (which equals price × quantity). Missing data affects several numeric fields and the discount flag, requiring careful handling for accurate aggregation.
key_observations: Total Spent is exactly Price Per Unit multiplied by Quantity in all sample rows, indicating it's a derived field.
Online (6,354) and In-store (6,221) transactions are nearly evenly split.
Payment methods are roughly balanced: Cash (4,310), Digital Wallet (4,144), Credit Card (4,121).
Numeric columns (Price Per Unit, Quantity, Total Spent) each have 4.8% missing values, likely from the same rows.
Discount Applied is missing for 33.4% of transactions, with True (4,219) slightly more than False (4,157) among non-missing.
Category distribution is relatively uniform, each around 1,568-1,591 transactions.
